sentences.text:
The applicant has filed this Application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for enlarging the applicant on Regular Bail in connection with FIR being I-CR.No.11191067230013 of 2023 registered with Cyber Crime Police Station, Dist.Ahmedabad for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 420, 477(A) and 120(B) of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 43A, 66(C), 66(D)
of IT Act.

2. sentences.text:
Per contra, learned APP Ms.Calla appearing for the respondent State authority opposed the present application contending inter alia that with the use of the ID and password belonging to the present applicant, false results for the driving test were published and on the basis of the said report,
the driving license came to be issued.
She submitted the present applicant was working as Assistant RTO and while working as such this scam had occurred.
She, therefore, prayed that present application may be dismissed.

4. Heard learned advocates for the parties and perused the record.
5.
The present applicant was arrested in connection with the offence in question on 27.07.2023.

As per the case of the prosecution was working as Assistant RTO NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/15462/2023 ORDER DATED: 19/10/2023 undefined at RTO Gandhinagar and while working as such, with the use of the ID and password given to the present applicant as ARTO,
Gandhinagar, some fake results of driving test were published and on the basis of such fake results,
driving licenses came to be issued.
The affidavit of the Investigating Officer indicates that IP address from which the results were pushed in the system does not belong to the present applicant.
It also appears that the ID and password given to the present applicant was in turn given to his sub-ordinate.
Considering these facts and the role of the present applicant, the present application deserves consideration and accordingly stands allowed.

The Applicant Accused is ordered to be released on bail in connection with the FIR being I-CR.No.11191067230013 of 2023 registered with Cyber Crime Police Station, Dist.Ahmedabad on executing a personal bond of Rs.10,000/- with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, subject to the following conditions that the applicant shall:
(a) not directly or indirectly make any NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/15462/2023 ORDER DATED: 19/10/2023 undefined inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the fact of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any Police Officer or tamper with the evidence.
(b) maintain law and order and not to indulge in any criminal activities.

(c) furnish the documentary proof of complete, correct and present address of residence to the Investigating Officer and to the Trial Court at the time of executing the bond and shall not change the residence without prior permission of the trial Court.
(d) provide contact numbers as well as the contact numbers of the sureties before the Trial Court.
In case of change in such numbers inform in writing immediately to the trial Court.

( e ) f i l e a n a f f i d a v i t s t a t i n g h i s i m m o v a b l e N E U T R A L C I T A T I O N R/CR.MA/15462/2023 ORDER DATED: 19/10/2023 undefined properties whether self acquired or ancestral with description, location and present value of such properties before the Trial Court, if any.
